title: Elephants Call Each Other by Name, Scientists Proved

scenes.text: Elephants have names. Scientists finally proved it.
They studied wild herds in Kenya, with recordings from 1986 to 2022.
An AI model learned from the rumbles and could predict who each call was meant for.
Then scientists played calls back to 17 elephants. Calls meant for them got more than twice as many replies.
Dolphins and parrots copy the other animal's sound. Elephants don't.
So yes: elephants really do have names.

description:
Elephants have names. Scientists finally proved it.
Wild African elephants in Kenya seem to call each other with name-like rumbles, and they answered much more to calls meant for them.
What would your elephant name sound like? Comment below.
first_comment: Calls to elephants without their name got far less response. What would your elephant name be?
